dct_description_sm: Map of the Indian Ocean region including the Middle East, East Africa, India and Southeast Asia.; Published in "Parergon, sive, Veteris geograpiae aliquot tabulae", part of the historical atlas section of Ortelius's "Theatrum orbis terrarum".; Relief shown pictorially.; Includes inset maps showing the west coast of Africa, the Arctic region, and the regions of Greece and southern Italy traveled by Odysseus.; In lower right corner: Cum Imp. Reg. et Cancellariae Brabantiae privilegio Decennali 1597.
27 x 46 centimeters on sheet 39 x 49 centimeters
